title: Hotfix: export copyJobRemoteItemsBatch (portal boot)
description:
Client portal failed to load after v0.0.61/62 because file-host-app.js imported copyJobRemoteItemsBatch from portal-files-api.js but that export was never shipped on the GITHUBS deploy tree (PIPELINK had it). Adds the export plus a per-item fallback when POST /api/files/copy-batch is missing.

Who is affected: anyone opening the PipeShare client portal on BASE/SaaS.
changeLog: Fallback to per-item copyOnly moves when /copy-batch is absent
